# Mintex Staffing

> Mintex Staffing is a staffing and recruitment agency based in Edison, New Jersey, connecting employers with vetted, ready-to-work talent across contract, contract-to-hire, and permanent placements.

## Industries Served
- [IT Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/it-staffing)
- [Healthcare Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/healthcare-staffing)
- [Engineering Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/engineering-staffing)
- [Manufacturing Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/manufacturing-staffing)
- [Finance Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/finance-staffing)
- [Administrative Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/administrative-staffing)
- [Sales Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/sales-staffing)
- [Customer Service Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/customer-service-staffing)
- [Logistics Staffing](https://www.mintexstaffing.com/industries/logistics-staffing)
